"},"$:/plugins/linonetwo/memeloop-agent-ui/readme":{"title":"$:/plugins/linonetwo/memeloop-agent-ui/readme","caption":"MemeLoop Agent UI","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"This example embeds the reusable `@memeloop/react-ui` Agent shell in TiddlyWiki through `tw-react`.

Open [[MemeLoop Agent]] for the full view, or use the //MemeLoop// sidebar tab. Both mount the same shared `AgentSessionController`/`AgentChatShell`, keep at most 50 messages and 256 KiB resident, and use revision-safe absolute timeline seeks. The example exposes agent and model selection. Dragging one or more TiddlyWiki tiddlers into either view atomically adds them to the next message as Wiki attachments; browser files are streamed in bounded chunks to the Desktop attachment store before a run is prepared.

The same widget follows the Wiki language direction and light/dark palette. Container queries collapse its controls for the narrow sidebar without maintaining a second UI implementation. If the Electron host is unavailable, it fails closed with a localized configuration action instead of calling missing services.

To bind a specific conversation:

```
<$memeloopAgentChat agentId="your-agent-instance-id" mode="full" />
```
